pgSettingsRows.name: DateStyle
pgSettingsRows.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the display format for date and time values.
pgSettingsRows.extra_desc: Also controls interpretation of ambiguous date inputs.

pgSettingsRows.name: IntervalStyle
pgSettingsRows.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the display format for interval values.

pgSettingsRows.name: TimeZone
pgSettingsRows.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the time zone for displaying and interpreting time stamps.

pgSettingsRows.name: application_name
pgSettingsRows.category: Reporting and Logging / What to Log
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the application name to be reported in statistics and logs.

pgSettingsRows.name: bytea_output
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the output format for bytea.

pgSettingsRows.name: client_encoding
pgSettingsRows.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the client's character set encoding.

pgSettingsRows.name: default_transaction_read_only
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the default read-only status of new transactions.

pgSettingsRows.name: extra_float_digits
pgSettingsRows.category: Client Connection Defaults / Locale and Formatting
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the number of digits displayed for floating-point values.
pgSettingsRows.extra_desc: This affects real, double precision, and geometric data types. A zero or negative parameter value is added to the standard number of digits (FLT_DIG or DBL_DIG as appropriate). Any value greater than zero selects precise output mode.

pgSettingsRows.name: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed idle time between queries, when in a transaction.
pgSettingsRows.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.

pgSettingsRows.name: integer_datetimes
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Shows whether datetimes are integer based.

pgSettingsRows.name: lock_timeout
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any wait for a lock.
pgSettingsRows.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.

pgSettingsRows.name: max_identifier_length
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Shows the maximum identifier length.

pgSettingsRows.name: max_index_keys
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Shows the maximum number of index keys.

pgSettingsRows.name: search_path
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the schema search order for names that are not schema-qualified.

pgSettingsRows.name: server_encoding
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Shows the server (database) character set encoding.

pgSettingsRows.name: server_version
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Shows the server version.

pgSettingsRows.name: server_version_num
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Shows the server version as an integer.

pgSettingsRows.name: standard_conforming_strings
pgSettingsRows.category: Version and Platform Compatibility / Previous PostgreSQL Versions
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Causes '...' strings to treat backslashes literally.

pgSettingsRows.name: statement_timeout
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the maximum allowed duration of any statement.
pgSettingsRows.extra_desc: A value of 0 turns off the timeout.

pgSettingsRows.name: transaction_isolation
pgSettingsRows.short_desc: Sets the current transaction's isolation level.
